decision.observation: At 10:50 pm the farmer is on the grass south of the bus-stop sidewalk. A reddish dirt path runs down and to the right toward the bottom of the screen.
decision.hypothesis: This dirt path is the southbound route back to the signpost road and the farm. Following it south should lead home before 2 am.
decision.memory: The bus front blocks the asphalt row. Going south from beside the bus front reaches the grass and the dirt path that leads south toward the farm road.
